Subject: Re: Panel scoring: Olivia Grant (SRE) — rubric I used + raw scores

Marcus —

I used 1–5 and emphasized system design slightly more because Olivia's solutions were conceptually strong but lighter on operational runbooks. My raw scores (in order: technical design, troubleshooting, systems thinking, culture fit): 4, 3, 4, 5. See attached export (olivia_scores_soojin.xlsx).

Short notes:
- Strengths: clear abstractions, solid latency/throughput tradeoffs.
- Risk: limited hands-on incident narrative (didn't cite postmortem ownership specifics).

If we weight design 60% and ops 40% she still clears a hire threshold for me.

— Soojin

Date: 2027-05-19T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Panel aggregate + proposed reconciliation method

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn on scorecards. I pulled what we have into a single sheet and there are 3 slightly different approaches: equal weight, design-heavy, and a 3-level freeform. To reduce churn I propose we use a weighted composite where: design = 50%, incident/runbooks = 30%, culture = 20%. Below is the current raw input (rounded):

- Soojin: design 4, ops 3, culture 5
- Ava: design 3, ops 4, culture 4
- Marcus: design 4, ops 4, culture 4 (drafted, pending final)
- Monica: (not yet in sheet)

If we apply the 50/30/20 weighting, composite looks close between a hire and hold — Marcus, can you confirm whether you want to:
1) call a tiebreaker and put candidate to onsite offers path, or
2) ask for 20–30 min follow-up with candidate focused on runbook ownership + incident postmortem examples?

Recruiting is ready to schedule either path next week. Also tagging Hana (external) so she can hold windows: hana@novaprise.com.

Laura

Attachment: panel_aggregate_scores.xlsx
Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qe6-panel-aggregate-scores

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hana Cho <hana@novaprise.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Panel aggregate + proposed reconciliation method — decision

Thanks all — and thanks Laura for the tidy aggregate.

I'm going to move Olivia forward to the final offer path. Rationale: collective view is that her design and systems thinking are above bar and the ops gap can be validated in a brief pre-offer check (2 targeted questions + ask for one recent postmortem). Recruiting, please schedule a 20-min follow-up with Olivia to cover those items; if satisfactory proceed with the standard offer approval flow.

Action items:
- Hana (recruiter): hold 2–3 slots next week for a 20-min ops check.
- Laura: kick off offer-approval doc (I'll sign off once follow-up confirms).
- Soojin/Ava/Monica: mark your final "confirm" or "veto" in the aggregate sheet after the follow-up.
